spec: Land acts: small ways the player changes the ground beside them (sim/land-acts.ts). Each act turns a tile whose current ground is in 'on' into 'becomes' (saved as a tile edit), spending 'cost' items and 'labour' from a daily budget (labourPerDay, refilled each dawn); 'yield' items are gained. 'tools' (optional) lists items of which the player must carry at least one (any of them; kept, not spent): crafted at a forge or workbench (data/items/recipes.json). Stepping stones only go where the water is shallow: natural dry land within shallowReach tiles. Edits within noticeRadiusTiles of a town are talked about there the next dawn ('heard' completes '<who> says someone ... outside <town>.'). log keeps the last logCap acts. Ground already drawn as a stream or a road/track is left alone, and so is a tile holding anything but clearsProps (small growth and stones cleared by the work); structures (farmsteads, fences, fields, camps) block it.

acts.label: Lay stepping stones
acts.done: You set stones into the shallows. The water can be waded here now.
acts.heard: laid stepping stones across the water

acts.label: Clear brush
acts.done: You hack the brush back to open ground and keep the wood.

acts.label: Mend the path
acts.done: You lay timber edging and tamp the ground. A path, for whoever comes next.
